name: northcinder
description: NorthCinder is a buyer-loyal shopping agent: criteria search, deterministic ranking, local mandate-gated checkout, price watches, and an audit trail for MCP hosts.
long_description: NorthCinder is an open MCP client that shops across stores in your own accounts and ranks purely on your stated criteria plus a merchant trust signal — never on ad spend. Sponsored offers are labeled and always rank below organic ones. Every purchase requires a per-purchase signed mandate you explicitly approve out of band; an agent can never self-approve a purchase.

serviceUrl.title: Your NorthCinder engine URL
serviceUrl.description: Base URL of the NorthCinder engine you run (local default: http://127.0.0.1:8790). The repository owner operates no endpoint.

clientKey.title: Your NorthCinder engine key
clientKey.description: Buyer-generated Bearer key for your NorthCinder engine (at least 16 characters). This is not an AI model-provider token.

configDir.title: Local config directory
configDir.description: Where the mandate keypair, audit log, watches, orders, and profile are stored (0600, local-only). Defaults to your OS config directory.
